approved.en: Ukraine is using naval drones to strike Russian warships in Libya’s Benghazi port and launching long-range attacks on Russian targets such as a missile fuel production facility in Tula Oblast, while Russian drones continue to hit Ukrainian energy, rail and civilian sites, injuring children. Kyiv has deployed a new laser weapon that shot down a Russian jet drone, and Russia reported the loss of a 13‑year-old soldier killed in combat. The United Nations Security Council warned that winter attacks on Ukraine’s power grid and Black Sea shipping threaten lives and global food supplies. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Ukraina bruker sjø-droner til å angripe russiske krigsskip i Benghazi-havnen i Libya og gjennomfører langdistanseangrep mot russiske mål som en missildrivstoffproduksjonsanlegg i Tula oblast, mens russiske droner fortsetter å treffe ukrainske energianlegg, jernbaner og sivile steder, og skader barn. Kyiv har tatt i bruk et nytt laservåpen som skjøt ned en russisk jet-drone, og Russland rapporterte tapet av en 13‑år gammel soldat drept i kamp. FNs sikkerhetsråd advarte om at vinterangrep på Ukrainas strømnett og skipsfarten i Svartehavet truer liv og den globale matforsyningen. Konflikten forårsaket 75 767 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Israel continues airstrikes in Gaza, killing two terrorists linked to Doctors Without Borders and targeting Hamas chief al-Hayya's son, who survived the strike. Hamas chief's last surviving son also escaped an Israeli attack in Gaza City. The Israeli security cabinet is set to discuss advancing the stalled Trump Gaza plan amid US pressure, while Abbas is preparing to label Hamas a terror group, paving the way for an Eisenkot coalition. The UN warns the Gaza war has undone 77 years of human development and deepening hunger across the Middle East. 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Hamas-sjefens siste overlevende sønn unnslapp også et israelsk angrep i Gaza-by. Det israelske sikkerhetsrådet skal diskutere å fremme den fastlåste Trump-planen for Gaza under press fra USA, mens Abbas forbereder å klassifisere Hamas som en terrororganisasjon, noe som legger til rette for en Eisenkot-koalisjon. FN advarer om at Gaza-krigen har tilbakestilt 77 år med menneskelig utvikling og forverrer sulten i Midtøsten. 21 440 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Israel is intensifying airstrikes and artillery against Hezbollah positions in southern Lebanon, while Hezbollah monitors Israeli naval forces from Lebanese fishing boats. The Lebanese prime minister says a proposal is under way to keep UNIFIL operating beyond the end of the year to avoid a security vacuum as the force prepares to withdraw. Lebanon fears Israel may impose a maritime buffer zone in its southern waters, and France is planning a phased withdrawal of international forces after UNIFIL leaves. The conflict has caused 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Den libanesiske statsministeren sier at et forslag er under arbeid for å holde FN-styrken i Libanon (UNIFIL) i drift utover årsskiftet for å unngå et sikkerhetsvakuum når styrken forbereder seg på å trekke seg tilbake. Libanon frykter at Israel kan innføre en maritim buffer­soner i deres sørlige farvann, og Frankrike planlegger en trinnvis tilbaketrekning av internasjonale styrker etter at UNIFIL forlater området. Konflikten har forårsaket 4 335 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Iran launched a drone that struck Kuwait, killing two Italian nationals, and Iran denies responsibility while Italy says the drone was made in Iran. Iran has hit the same merchant vessels twice to deter traffic through the Strait of Hormuz and the US military has disabled two commercial ships attempting to breach Iran's blockade in the Gulf of Oman. Australia sanctioned Iranian agents suspected of directing antisemitic attacks in Sydney and Melbourne. The conflict continues with ongoing missile activity and development of an underground facility between key nuclear sites. 123 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

Australia innførte sanksjoner mot iranske agenter som mistenkes for å ha dirigert antisemittiske angrep i Sydney og Melbourne. Konflikten pågår med fortsatt missilaktivitet og utvikling av en underjordisk installasjon mellom viktige atomsteder. 123 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

Saudi forces responded with a strike in Taiz that killed eleven civilians, according to Houthi media. Iran denied involvement in a drone attack that killed two Italians in Kuwait. The Mecca pact’s collective defence promise is being discussed for possible implementation. The conflict caused 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Saudi-styrkene svarte med et angrep i Taiz som drepte elleve sivile, ifølge houthi-media. Iran avviste involvering i et droneangrep som drepte to italienere i Kuwait. President Al Zaidi called for dialogue and constitutional commitment as former US diplomat criticism of the Erbil-Baghdad dispute continued, and Trump backed Al Zaidi's authority. The UCDP recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: RSF forces have stepped up drone attacks, striking a United Nations building and residential neighborhoods in Khartoum, killing four people, and hitting civilians in Blue Nile state, killing 19 and displacing thousands near Ed Damazin. RSF-aligned troops assaulted aid offices in Nyala and a shelter in West Kordofan, causing civilian casualties. A RSF counterintelligence chief and a commander have defected to the Sudanese army in Khartoum, indicating shifting loyalties. New displacement alerts show thousands fleeing to locations such as Al Ferdous in East Darfur and As Salam in West Kordofan, while dengue fever cases are reported in El Geneina, West Darfur. The conflict produced 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: RSF-militsen har økt droneangrepene, og har truffet en FN-bygning og boligområder i Khartoum, drept fire personer, og rammet sivile i delstaten Blue Nile, drept 19 og fordrevet tusenvis nær Ed Damazin. RSF-tilknyttede tropper angrep hjelpekontorer i Nyala og et tilfluktssted i Vest-Kordofan, noe som førte til sivile tap. En etterretningssjef i RSF og en kommandør har gått over til den sudanske hæren (SAF) i Khartoum, noe som viser skiftende lojaliteter. Nye fordrivelsesvarsler viser at tusenvis flykter til steder som Al Ferdous i Øst-Darfur og As Salam i Vest-Kordofan, mens denguefebertilfeller rapporteres i El Geneina, Vest-Darfur. Konflikten førte til 4 680 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: President Salva Kiir lifted the state of emergency in four states ahead of the 2027 elections while ethnic violence persisted, including gunmen opening fire on a Juba-Mundri vehicle that injured two passengers and fighting in Wau town. An aid worker was killed, a Christian woman was slain for refusing a forced marriage, and 26 people were killed in an attack on SSPDF barracks in Warrap state. Jonglei authorities handed over six more abductees to Pibor and a strike by truck drivers on the main highway was resolved after a deal with the government. The UN warned that hunger is worsening sharply because of conflict and El Niño, and there were 2 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

En hjelpearbeider ble drept, en kristen kvinne ble drept for å ha nektet et tvangs ekteskap, og 26 personer ble drept i et angrep på SSPDF-barrikader i delstaten Warrap. Myndighetene i Jonglei overleverte seks flere bortførte til Pibor, og en streik blant lastebilsjåfører på hovedveien ble løst etter en avtale med regjeringen. FN advarte om at sulten forverres kraftig på grunn av konflikt og El Niño, og det var 2 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Ethiopian forces have captured Gual Gemahalo near Badme and are fighting Eritrean-backed fighters while shelling Alamata, and Somali militants attacked an Ethiopian base killing 43 soldiers. Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed warned Eritrea to stop supporting Ethiopia's enemies and announced the resumption of Ethiopian Airlines flights to Aksum and the escort of 300 Kenyan trucks across Moyale after a ceasefire. Eritrea has accused Ethiopia of using Red Sea diplomacy to advance territorial ambitions and the war in Amhara is threatening water security in the Nile Basin. A machine-learning analysis shows sharp geographic divides in Ethiopian digital activism.

Eritrea har anklaget Etiopia for å bruke diplomati i Rødehavet for å fremme territorielle ambisjoner, og krigen i Amhara truer vannforsyningen i Nilen. approved.en: Somali federal forces and U.S. airstrikes have recently killed dozens of al-Shabaab militants in Lower Shabelle, including a strike that killed 60 militants and another that killed 61 militants, while Somali troops eliminated two al-Shabaab logistics operatives in the same region. The Somali president has accused the UAE of financing armed groups, and the parliament speaker has blamed Kenya, Ethiopia and Uganda for colluding with al-Shabaab. The African Union approved a new three-phase plan to reduce its troops in Somalia, warning of a possible al-Shabaab resurgence as foreign forces withdraw. The conflict caused 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Den somaliske presidenten har anklaget De forente arabiske emirater for å finansiere væpnede grupper, og parlamentets talsperson har lagt skylden på Kenya, Etiopia og Uganda for å samarbeide med al-Shabaab. Den afrikanske unionen godkjente en ny tre-fasers plan for å redusere sine tropper i Somalia, og advarte om en mulig al-Shabaab-gjenoppblussing når utenlandske styrker trekker seg tilbake. Boko Haram insurgents have resurfaced in northern Cameroon, adding a new security threat to the region.
